Langley bathroom renovation costs in 2026 range from $18,000 for a powder room refresh to $100,000 for a spa-level master ensuite, depending on scope, finishes, and the specific neighbourhood. Reno Stars has completed bathroom projects across Walnut Grove, Willoughby, Brookswood, and the Langley Township — with real project costs pulled from our database below.

Unlike estimates you find in generic articles, every price on this page comes from an actual Langley-area project we completed in 2025 or 2026.

What Drives a Langley Bathroom Renovation Cost Up in 2026

Several factors push costs higher than the baseline in Langley specifically:

  • Willoughby and Walnut Grove newer homes — Many homes built after 2010 have dual-pane windows and modern layouts, but the bathroom fixtures and finishes haven't been updated since original construction. These homes often need full fixture replacements rather than surface-level updates.
  • BC Building Code Part 9 compliance — Any bathroom renovation involving plumbing relocation, drain changes, or new wet-area construction requires BC Building Code Part 9 compliance. In Langley (within the Township of Langley), this means coordination with the Langley Building Division for inspections.
  • Asbestos testing in pre-1990 homes — Brookswood and the original Langley City homes dating from the 1960s–1980s may contain asbestos in floor tiles, wallboard, or pipe insulation. BC law requires asbestos testing before demolition in these homes. Budget $800–$3,000 for testing and abatement if your home was built before 1990.
  • Trucking and trade availability — Willoughby is one of the fastest-growing neighbourhoods in Metro Vancouver. Trade availability is better than in North Vancouver or West Vancouver, but skilled tile setters and plumbers still carry a premium compared to Surrey or Delta.

Do You Need a Permit for a Langley Bathroom Renovation?

In the Langley Township (covering Willoughby, Walnut Grove, Brookswood, Aldergrove, and the original Langley City), permits are required when:

  • The scope involves moving or adding plumbing fixtures (toilet, sink, shower, tub)
  • A load-bearing wall is being modified
  • The renovation creates a new wet area or changes the bathroom's footprint
  • Electrical panel upgrades or new circuits are involved

Cosmetic renovations — painting, replacing a vanity in the same location, refinishing a bathtub — typically do not require a permit in Langley. Reno Stars handles all permit applications as part of our standard project delivery.

Frequently Asked Questions — Langley Bathroom Renovation

How much does a bathroom renovation cost in Langley, BC in 2026?

A standard bathroom renovation in Langley (Willoughby, Walnut Grove, or Brookswood) costs between $20,000 and $50,000 depending on whether it is a cosmetic refresh or a full gut with custom tile, waterproofing, and premium fixtures. A luxury spa-level master bathroom can reach $100,000–$200,000. These figures include all labour, materials, permits, and our 3-year warranty.

Do I need a permit for a bathroom renovation in the Langley Township?

You need a permit when moving plumbing fixtures, modifying a load-bearing wall, or creating a new wet area. Cosmetic updates like vanity replacement, painting, and tub refinishing typically do not require a permit in Langley. Reno Stars manages the permit application process for every project that requires one.

What is the difference between a shower conversion and a full bathroom renovation?

A shower conversion replaces an existing tub with a standalone shower unit — typically a 1–2 week project costing $3,500–$12,000. A full bathroom renovation replaces all fixtures, flooring, and surfaces and may involve layout changes — typically 3–7 weeks and $20,000–$60,000. A shower conversion can be a first step toward a full renovation later.

How long does a bathroom renovation take in Langley?

A standard powder room refresh takes 1–2 weeks. A full 3-piece bathroom renovation with new tile, fixtures, and vanity takes 3–4 weeks for a standard scope, and 5–8 weeks if the scope includes layout changes, curbless shower construction, or heated flooring. Luxury master ensuites run 8–16 weeks depending on the finish level.
